mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task ( name, type, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, last_error_message ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{type}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetryCount}, #{lastErrorMessage} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, last_error_message, created_at, updated_at, started_at FROM task WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, type, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, last_error_message, created_at, updated_at, started_at FROM task ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, max_retry_count = #{maxRetryCount} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, last_error_message, created_at, updated_at, started_at FROM task WHERE status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, type, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, last_error_message, created_at, updated_at, started_at FROM task WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = #{toStatus}, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, last_error_message, created_at, updated_at, started_at FROM task WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) > #{timeoutSeconds} ORDER BY started_at ASC
